name: Attribute-Conditioned SH Enhancement
definition: A module that predicts Gaussian-aware offsets based on intrinsic Gaussian attributes to enhance first-order SH representation prior to inference.
summary: Attribute-Conditioned SH Enhancement recovers high-frequency details lost in low-order Spherical Harmonics by predicting view-independent offsets from Gaussian attributes and statically baking them, eliminating rendering overhead.
